# Platform

<!-- mirage:section targets -->
## Supported platforms and versions

The two most recent major versions of each mobile OS (Q-010).

<!-- mirage:section distribution -->
## Distribution and review

Both public app stores, published from the shop's own accounts (IN-002).

<!-- mirage:section permissions -->
## Permissions

Notifications only.

<!-- mirage:section updates -->
## Updates

Store updates; a minimum version check blocks very old builds.

<!-- mirage:section signing -->
## Signing and credentials

The shop owner holds the signing credentials.

<!-- mirage:section crashes -->
## Crash reporting

Crash reports go to the error tracking account.
